answer: Compare against the naive design, which trusts the first 5 votes it gets. Instead, draw jurors after commit, require a median within 1 point, and slash any juror outside it. Expire standing unless fresh work renews it. The cheapest attack is no longer one bought panel; it is 5 bonded seats that must agree and survive an audit. A sonnet of copied prose renews nothing, and a meadow of idle keys buys no knoll.
